notes.title: The release schedule for the first DLC has been changed
notes.content:
We are forced to inform players that the release of the Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 2 has been postponed to late spring - early summer. The reason for these changes is that this part will be longer than the first one. Also, the new DLC will reveal to us a lot of secrets and mysteries related to the past of the main characters. How did they live before the world fell? What happened in the first few days after the virus spread?

Add the game to your Wishlist so that you don't miss the latest trailer and the announcement of new chapters.

notes.title: First DLC Announcement
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the first DLC called Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 2. It's a direct sequel to the story of Liam and his friends' survival in a fading zombie world, which will be released in Q1 2025. Part two will include new scenes, encounters, locations, and even more electricity between characters. 

Also, in response to questions from players who have already purchased the first part of the game, we confirm that the DLC will be free. So support our project by remembering to add it to your Wishlist!

We'll be revealing more information soon🙂.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333440/Sexy_Apocalypse_Girls_Part_II/

notes.title: The Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 1 is available now!
notes.content:
Survive, fight zombies and make friends (or enemies) in the first part of the game now! The fascinating and horny story of Liam, who embarks on a long journey to achieve a cherished goal is already waiting for you. Along the way, he will encounter various difficulties (and sometimes pleasant moments), but we are sure you will be able to help him overcome them all!

The Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 1 contained the following four chapters:

 ⁃ Loneliness is not forever
 ⁃ The Desert of Death
 ⁃ Uninvited guests
 ⁃ Deep in the woods

Thanks for your support and interest in the project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2754140/Sexy_Apocalypse_Girls_Part_I/

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Well, that's great news! We are happy to announce that the Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 1 will be released on July 12th. [/b]

Our focus is on polishing the interface and sound effects at the moment. This means that soon everyone will be able to try himself as a survivor, fighting off zombies and meeting hot girls. 

If you're interested in the project, add it to your Wishlist and stay tuned for updates.

notes.title: Important news and changes in the Sexy Apocalypse Girls
notes.content:
We have to inform you that for reasons beyond our control, the Sexy Apocalypse Girls is no longer in the Early Access. So that players can still enjoy the story as soon as possible, the project is renamed the Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Part 1.

The exact release date will be announced soon, but in the meantime, take a look at the project's roadmap.

notes.title: The Official Reveal Trailer is now available on Steam.
notes.content:
Lift the veil of mystery and peer into the world of the Sexy Apocalypse Girls. In the Reveal Trailer, you can see small snippets of dialogue, hot scenes, and gameplay. We can't wait to introduce you to all the characters and their story.

Stay tuned for updates so you don't miss the Early Access release date.

notes.title: #Devlog 0.3
notes.content:
We continue to tell you about the gameplay of Sexy Apocalypse Girls.

In the game you will play as Liam — a simple guy with a complicated destiny. Fortunately, he won't be alone on his journey. He will always be surrounded by different characters with their own stories and personalities. Sometimes the plot will have you playing as each of them and solving their problems to better understand how the characters think and act in a given situation. Therefore, the ending of not only the protagonist, but also his friends will depend on you.

Add the game to Wishlist to support the project and not to miss new updates.

notes.title: #Devlog 0.2
notes.content:
[b]Sexy Apocalypse Girls is basically an adult visual novel with juicy pictures and an interesting story, though it does include some game mechanics. 
[/b]
For example, according to the plot, in one chapter you will shoot off zombies, and in another you will make a fire to survive. All this is done in order to immerse the player deeper into the amazing and exciting atmosphere of the post-apocalypse. 

[b]Follow our news not to miss more information about the game!
[/b]

notes.title: #Devlog 0.1
notes.content:
[b]We've noticed a lot of questions about the upcoming Early Access release of Sexy Apocalypse Girls. Well, let's reveal some details.
[/b]
Early access will consist of 4 chapters with a variety of beautiful locations. It's over two hours of unforgettable adventure. You'll meet different characters, including three hot girls you can spend time with.

Also, don't forget about the choices you'll make throughout the game. The choices in the first 4 chapters will affect both getting new scenes and the future ending of the story.

If you're interested in the project, add it to your Wishlist and stay tuned for updates.
